authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL ḍhiḍḍha belly subsection 1 explicitly gives Awankari ḍhiḍ and Punjabi ḍhiḍḍ(h). Selected Awankari, Gojri and Dogri i-vowel ḍiḍ/ṭiḍ forms and close Awankari/Gojri ṭeḍh/teḍ variants fit this regional family, preserving aspiration, initial voicing and vowel notation. Regional aspiration/voicing developments and transmission remain qualified; the separate unaspirated Sindhi branch is not chosen just from surface absence of h. The full same-family slash response is retained. The similar heap entry 5598 is not substituted for the directly documented belly entry. Exact response: ṭiḍ.
